results.name: Mother's baby dress
results.description:
My submission for #AgisoftClothesChallenge

My mother got this dress when she was around 1-2 years old.
She used to live in Norilsk, where locals considered other parts of then USSR a "continent" while they were "stranded" with little connection to the outside world but ships and infrequent airplanes.
These circumstances add a bit more background to the story of this Hungarian dress. 
Unfortunately, I can't ask my grandmother how exactly she acquired it. But it was quite hard to get an item of high quality made in the countries of the Soviet block and not a usually low-quality USSR made ones.
I also reflect on the social status my mother's family used to have – money alone could not have bought such a nice thing in those times.

I've recently made a photo of my daugther wearing the dress, so it serves the third generation already. Now, more as a memento and a family relic.

I've put all the technical details of the scan in a forum post:
https://forum.sketchfab.com/t/my-clothes-challenge-experience/34435
